srg_output_dir.description: Directory to output HTML files to.

srg_output_url.description: URL that the output directory is accessible at.

srg_resource_dir.description: Directory containing required resources for SRG.

srg_title.description: Title for use in HTML headers.

srg_groupby.description: Group reports by 'U' for user, 'A' for address or 'S' for subnet.

srg_groupbynetmask.description: The netmask to be used when grouping by subnet.

srg_time_period.description: Set start and end times to create logs for.

srg_phpheader.description: PHP Header file to include with reports.

srg_phpfooter.description: PHP Footer file to include with reports.

srg_max_age.description: Maximum age (in days) of a report.

srg_destinationsitefilter_file.description: File containing destination site filter entries.

srg_show_times.description: Include time values in HTML reports.

srg_show_rates.description: Include 'transfer rate' values in HTML reports.

srg_lookup_hosts.description: Perform DNS lookups on hostnames expressed as IP addresses.

srg_iptouser_file.description: File to convert client IP address to a username.

srg_nonameexists_showip.description: Show IP address if username doesn't exist.

srg_dontshow_onlydeniedusers.description: Don't show users who only have denied hits.

srg_minimum_connects.description: Exclude sites/users with less than this number of requests from the report.
